content.title: Poncho El Castor [Demo]
about: Poncho El Castor is a 3D collectible adventure where you explore, solve puzzles, and gather artifacts.
After a mysterious object falls from the sky, the mayor asks Poncho to retrieve five artifacts to open its door and uncover what it is.
This was my first fully solo 3D project and was released as a Windows demo.
features: 3D puzzle-platforming with collectibles and simple objectives
Low-poly visual style and short-session pacing
learnings: End-to-end 3D production as a solo developer
Implementing collectible objectives and basic puzzle flow
Publishing a playable demo and iterating on feedback
